description:
In a remote mountain village under the watchful eyes of two stone guardians, the young Yuru contentedly lives off the land while staying close to the only family he has left—Asa, his precious twin sister. Asa, meanwhile, carries out a mysterious “duty” on behalf of the village while locked in a cage. Why is Asa a prisoner? And what other secrets does Yuru’s otherwise idyllic home hide?

(Source: Square Enix)

node.description:
__Birthplace:__ Resembool, Amestris
__Height:__ 1,65m
__Family:__ [Alphonse Elric](https://anilist.co/character/12/Alphonse-Elric) (brother), [Van Hohenheim](https://anilist.co/character/9792/Van-Hohenheim) (father), [Trisha Elric](https://anilist.co/character/10085/Trisha-Elric) (mother, deceased)
__Affiliations:__ State Military, [Pinako Rockbell](https://anilist.co/character/65/Pinako-Rockbell), [Izumi Curtis (teacher)](https://anilist.co/character/67/Izumi-Curtis), [Roy Mustang (Commander)](https://anilist.co/character/68/Roy-Mustang)
__Occupation:__ State Alchemist

Edward "Fullmetal Alchemist" Elric is a young alchemical prodigy. He is the youngest State Alchemist ever to be recognized by the Amestris State Military, having received the title at the age of 12. Ed's primary motivation throughout the series is to return his younger brother, Alphonse, to his original body, which was lost in a failed human transmutation. Edward, despite his occasional bouts of immaturity, is a selfless boy who gains a reputation as a "hero of the people" throughout his youth. Notably, he doesn't seem concerned about returning his own arm and leg, instead focusing entirely on Al's suffering.

Edward is small for his age, standing at only 149 cm (4'11"), however his body is that of an experienced martial artist, with noticeable muscles and a wealth of agility. Although he lacks both his right arm and left leg, Ed's ability to fight is not impaired, and is in fact improved, as he will often use alchemy to cause his metal arm to partly transform into a blade or shield. His heavy automail limbs are considered by him to be the very best in Amestris. They were made by his childhood friend, Winry Rockbell, and she is constantly working on them. He is able to think quickly, even in desperate situations, though can still be frightened into paralysis. These qualities, combined with his alchemical powers and physical strength, make him a formidable fighter.

node.description:
__Birthplace:__ Resembool
__Family:__ [Edward Elric](https://anilist.co/character/11) (brother), [Trisha Elric](https://anilist.co/character/10085) (mother, deceased)
__Occupation:__ Alchemist

Alphonse Elric is a human child who lost his body during a forbidden alchemical transmutation to bring his deceased mother back to life, and had his soul transmuted into a suit of armor by his brother, Edward Elric. 

Al's blood seal lies just below the base of the neck at the back of the suit, on the inside. It is drawn with Ed's blood. According to Edward, he needs to be careful whenever he reconstructs Alphonse's body because he must keep the blood seal intact during the transmutation. If the blood seal is removed, Al's soul will be lost.

__Daemons:__ Sayuu-sama ([Hidari](https://anilist.co/character/287182/) and [Migi](https://anilist.co/character/324638/))~!Later, Zashiki-Warashi ([Danji](https://anilist.co/character/395406/) and [Kiri](https://anilist.co/character/270809/))!~

The elder twin. A blond-haired boy who embodies the Night. Rescued from the village by [Dera](https://anilist.co/character/334313/) and [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/334316/) during the massacre, his primary goal is to find [his younger sister](https://anilist.co/character/270810/), parents [Mine](https://anilist.co/character/395408/) and [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/395409/), and uncover the cause of the conflict unfolding around them. Including finding out why his sister's comrades killed adults in his village and taking revenge on them. As someone who has spent his entire life in a village preserving the Edo-period way of life, Yuru acts like a traveler from the past, unprepared for modern life, yet quickly navigating complex situations thanks to his advanced hunting skills.

__Master:__ [Yuru](https://anilist.co/character/270811/)

Formerly the left statue in the settlement, she now takes the form of a muscular, tall woman reminiscent of an oni. Like [Right](https://anilist.co/character/324638), she values strength and communicates in an old-fashioned manner, but in contrast, she has a more phlegmatic personality.

__Daemons:__ [Kai](https://anilist.co/character/398964/), [Inyou](https://anilist.co/character/397635/) (Ohagi and Daifuku)
__Affiliation:__ Kagemori Family

The younger of the twins. A tall, masculine girl who embodies the Day. Although she displays a very tough character and a readiness for violence in critical situations, she is also a reliable friend to [Jin](https://anilist.co/character/321814/) and [Gabby](https://anilist.co/character/321813/), and has a pronounced brother complex towards [Yuru](https://anilist.co/character/270811/) due to their long separation. She actually left the village at a young age with her parents, and a ["False Asa"](https://anilist.co/character/270809/) with a more idealized personality and the ability to regenerate lived in the settlement in her place.

__Daemon:__ [Gabriel](https://anilist.co/character/394436/) (Joe William Frederic Gabriel I and Kirk Douglas Auldglaive Gabriel II)
__Affiliation:__ Kagemori Family

A blonde teenage girl with a Daemon shaped like a floating pair of teeth with eyes named Gabriel. Although she is initially introduced as a cynical and cruel killer who kills anyone regardless of gender or threat, she is also shown as convincingly not harming children, and acting like a normal teenager when interacting with her friends.

__Master:__ [Yuru](https://anilist.co/character/270811/)

Formerly the right statue in the settlement, he now takes the form of a large, very muscular man reminiscent of an oni. He possesses the mentality of an old-fashioned, communicative warrior who relishes battle, but is completely devoted to his master's commands.

__Nationality:__ Amestrian

Nina's father is [Shou Tucker](https://anilist.co/character/3696/), the Sowing Life Alchemist.  

~! When her father became desperate in forming another talking chimera he transmuted her and [her dog](https://anilist.co/character/404360/) into a chimera that was able to speak the human language.  Shortly after, she is killed by Scar to put her out of her misery. Later on in the first anime, with the philosopher's stone, the disfigured Chimeric Shou Tucker is able to resurrect his fallen daughter into the form of a chimera homunculus, an artificial human being. However, she never speaks and little is known about what happens after that.!~

A middle-aged man with slightly gray hair, initially portrayed as a traveling merchant, who serves as a link between the villagers and the outside world. In reality, he is a member of a long line of skilled warriors, capable of defeating a group of soldiers unarmed, and sent by his family to rescue and protect [Yuru](https://anilist.co/character/270811/Yuru) from hostile or dangerous individuals seeking to exploit him. He works in tandem with [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/334316/Danno-Hana), and occasionally flirts with her, half-jokingly convincing her to marry him as part of the cover story of his new young wife and stepmother to Yuru.

__Daemons:__ Zenko Kourou ([Kotetsu](https://anilist.co/character/397198/) and [Jirou](https://anilist.co/character/397199/))

A young woman who helps [Dera](https://anilist.co/character/334313/) protect [Yuru](https://anilist.co/character/270811/). Although she sincerely helps protect the boy, she reluctantly accepts the cover story of being Dera's young, new wife, even though she actually dreams of Jason Statham as her ideal man.

__Birthplace:__ Amestris
__Occupation:__ State Alchemist

The "Sewing-Life" Alchemist who created a talking chimera. Later on it is realized that the first speaking chimera he created was made from lab animals and his wife who he transmuted into a chimera out of a fit of anger.    ~!He also created a second "talking chimera" by transmuting his daughter Nina and his dog.!~  In the 2003 Series:   ~!Later on he makes another appearance at the abandoned lab. He is first thought to be a chimera by Ed, when he can see Shou's twisted body wrapped around the creature's upper body due to a failed alchemy experiment. Shou then wishes Ed to complete the philosopher's stone so he can then resurrect Nina whom he killed in the first place.!~

__Daemons:__ Sukabenjaa "The Scavenger" ([Ai](https://anilist.co/character/396609/) and [Makoto](https://anilist.co/character/396610/))
__Affiliation:__ Kagemori Family

Jin is a Tsugai user and member of the Kagemori Family. He's first seen picking up [Asa](https://anilist.co/character/270810/Asa) and [Gabby](https://anilist.co/character/321813/Gabby) from the raid on Higashi Village.

__Daemons:__ Magatsuhi ([Daikyo](https://anilist.co/character/403335/) and [Shokyo](https://anilist.co/character/403336/))
__Affiliation:__ Nishino Village

A bloodthirsty assassin affiliated with Nishino Village and the alleged murderer of [Mine](https://anilist.co/character/395408/Mine) and [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/395409/Kinjou-Nagisa).

__Daemons:__ Kinugyokuto "Sun and Moon" ([Yozakura](https://anilist.co/character/401078/) and [Asagiri](https://anilist.co/character/401063/))
__Affiliation:__ Kagemori Family

[Jin](https://anilist.co/character/321814/)'s older half-brother. Asuma is an ominous person who usually gives the wrong impression since he acts suspiciously and attracts a lot of attention.

__Master:__ [Oshirasama no Aruji no Mago](https://anilist.co/character/403916/) (current), [Oshirasama no Aruji](https://anilist.co/character/403338/) (former)

A god-like pair of tsugai consisting of a young woman and a stallion.

They are known for their friendly nature, preferring to live peacefully alongside humans. Their human side can communicate with both tsugai and humans and is attentive to children. They are old acquaintances of [Hidari](https://anilist.co/character/287182/) and [Migi](https://anilist.co/character/324638/).

Oshira has been passed down through generations of a family thanks to a blood ritual. This allows her to live freely without worrying about disappearing.

~!__Master:__ [Kyouka](https://anilist.co/character/395411/)!~

The person showered with love as the twin of [Yuru](https://anilist.co/character/270811/Yuru).

~!It has been revealed that she was a puppet to bind Yuru to the village. She is actually a tsugai named Kiri and partnered with [Danji](https://anilist.co/character/395406/) to form the pair "Zashiki-Warashi"!~

__Daemons:__ Kame to Usagi "Tortoise and Hare" ([Kame-chan](https://anilist.co/character/397201/) and [Usa-chan](https://anilist.co/character/397200/))

The youngest of the Kuroya foster siblings. He is kind, but fiercely loyal.

__Master:__ [Gabby](https://anilist.co/character/321813/)

The Daemon pair serving Gabby-chan, which take the appearance of one circular flying upper and lower jaws with eyes, respectively. They can expand and bite off chunks of flesh from enemies, or shield their owner.

__Daemons:__ Hyakkiyakoi (Unnamed), Centimanus (Unnamed), Uyamuya (Unnamed).
__Affiliation:__ Kagemori Family

Gonzo is the father of [Hikaru](https://anilist.co/character/398959/), [Asuma](https://anilist.co/character/334315/) and [Jin](https://anilist.co/character/321814/) as well as the leader of the Kagemori Family. His kind appearance hides his authoritarian and self-serving nature. However, he actually cares about his clan and the people who work with the clan.

~!__Daemons:__ Tenaga-Ashinaga ([Tenaga](https://anilist.co/character/399888/) and [Ashinaga](https://anilist.co/character/399889/%E8%B6%B3%E9%95%B7))!~

[Ryu](https://anilist.co/character/334313/)'s Ethiopian 13-year-old half-brother. He is sensitive, shy and inexperienced with Daemons.

~!__Master:__ [Kyouka](https://anilist.co/character/395411/)!~

Danji is a young man and good friend of [Yuru](https://anilist.co/character/270811/).~!Later, it is revealed that Danji is actually one half of a tsugai called Zashiki-Warashi along with [Kiri](https://anilist.co/character/270809/). Danji's true form consists of a small, cartoonish shape, his hair is tied up and he wears old-fashioned clothes.!~

__Daemons:__ Kokubyaku ([White](https://anilist.co/character/399400/) and [Beta](https://anilist.co/character/399401/))
__Affiliation:__ Kagemori Family

Gonzo's kind and overweight oldest son and heir of the clan, who spends most of his time as a manga artist under the pen name Hikaru Hakurei.~!He later becomes the head of the Kagemori clan after Gonzo's death at the hands of Misasagi.!~

__Daemons:__ Namomihagi ([Jijimaru](https://anilist.co/character/405439/) and [Babamaru](https://anilist.co/character/405440/))
__Affiliation:__ Kagemori Family

The oldest of the Kuroya bodyguards. She is very diligent and serious about her job, but loving to her family.

__Master:__ [Makoto Tachikawa](https://anilist.co/character/398212/)
__Master:__ [Jin Kagemori](https://anilist.co/character/321814/)

__Affiliation:__ Kagemori Family

One of the mercenary Daemon wielders, who was hired to attack the Kagemori estate to retrieve the twins. Following their defeat, Gonzo recruits her to the family and offers to pay for her sick mother's treatment.

__Daemons:__ Blacklist ([Whisper](https://anilist.co/character/399882/) and [Embrace](https://anilist.co/character/399890/))
__Affiliation:__ Kagemori Family

The second child of the Kuroya family, a calm and quiet person.
Alexander is the family pet of the Tucker Family and [Nina's](https://anilist.co/character/4159/) inseparable best friend.

An outsider from Okinawa Island who accidentally discovered Higashi Village, where she fell in love with [Mine](https://anilist.co/character/395408) and gave birth to [Yuru](https://anilist.co/character/270811/) and [Asa](https://anilist.co/character/270810/).

A shy little girl from Higashi Village and one of the few survivors of [Gabby](https://anilist.co/character/321813/)'s attack on the village. She later resides on the Danno household after being kidnapped out of the village as a hostage along with [Kiri](https://anilist.co/character/270809/), fearing of what consequences the village would do to her for secrecy.
The head doctor for the Kagemori clan, who dislikes treating wounded, despite her uncompromising professionalism.
__Master:__ [Makoto Tachikawa](https://anilist.co/character/398212/)

__Daemons:__ Tama Korogashi (Hime and Tarou)
__Affiliation:__ Nishino Village

Anna Mineyama is a high school student who spends her free time working with [Ivan](https://anilist.co/character/324639/) as his cleaner. She is affiliated with Nishino village, working with them even outside of her work for Ivan.
A Higashi Village resident and the father of [Yuru](https://anilist.co/character/270811/) and [Asa](https://anilist.co/character/270810/). He is a kind man and a great hunter.

__Daemons:__ Fujin-Raijin ([Fujin](https://anilist.co/character/403333/) and [Raijin](https://anilist.co/character/403334/))

Asuma's maternal uncle. He is highly intellectual and self-centered, believing himself to be superior to others.

Iori Shingo was a member of Shingo family until she met [Gonzo Kagemori](https://anilist.co/character/397195/) who invited her to be part of his family and they eventually had a son, [Asuma](https://anilist.co/character/334315/). Her older brother is [Hayato Shingou](https://anilist.co/character/401992/).

__Daemons:__ Yama no Kami "Mountain God" ([Yamakaze](https://anilist.co/character/405437/) and [Tanikaze](https://anilist.co/character/405438/))
__Affiliation:__ Nishino Village

An expressionless member of the Kuroya family, who serve as bodyguards to the Kagemori clan. ~!However, he is actually a spy from Nishino Village, tasked with killing Yuru and Asa once they are reunited. Akio was born unable to feel pain, though it is implied that his mother sealed his ability to feel pain.!~
__Master:__ [Asa](https://anilist.co/character/270810/) (current), [Kenichi Hamura](https://anilist.co/character/398213/) (former)

__Daemons:__ Formerly, [Inyou](https://anilist.co/character/397635/) (Ohagi and Daifuku)
__Affiliation:__ Kagemori Family

A negligent Daemon wielder and mercenary, who took the job to attack the Kagemori estate in order to square off his debt. Following his defeat, Asa uses Break to liberate his Daemons and he is recruited as a foot soldier.
__Master:__ [Fuyuki Kuroya](https://anilist.co/character/399878/)
__Master:__ [Fuyuki Kuroya](https://anilist.co/character/399878/)

Roei Tadera is a middle-aged trader, former protector of Higashi Village, previous head of Tadera Family and father of [Ryuu](https://anilist.co/character/334313/) and [Ken Tadera](https://anilist.co/character/334314/).
The elder leader of Higashi Village. While she cares about her village, she is opportunistic and desires to use Yuru and Asa.

__Daemons:__ Zashiki-Warashi ~!([Danji](https://anilist.co/character/395406/) and [Kiri](https://anilist.co/character/270809/))!~

A Higashi Village retainer, Nagisa's childhood friend supporting Yamaha. Unlike other residents who wish to exploit the twins' powers, she sympathizes with them and wants them to live normal lives.

__Master:__ [Asa](https://anilist.co/character/270810/)

A one half of the Daemon pair residing in Yomotsu Hirasaka, the border realm between the living and the dead. This realm is accessible only by the twins after they have died once. Break has a vaguely humanoid appearance, clad in white drapes. Break allows its master to break anything, physical or conceptual, that they point to.
[Hikaru's](https://anilist.co/character/398959) editor.
